# Security Architecture Template Creation Guidelines

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../../README.md) • [Work Templates](../../README.md) • [Artifacts](./README.md)**

[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#10-overview]

## 1.0 Overview

These templates produce TOGAF-aligned security architecture artifacts for the Gainwell Enterprise Architecture Program. They follow the TOGAF Architecture Development Method (ADM) phase sequence from Architecture Vision (Phase A) through Migration Planning (Phase F).

**Security Domain Routing**: Per the [Security Domain Routing Decision](../../../../foundation/CONTRIBUTING.md#domain-content-routing-decisions), all security architecture content — including artifacts produced from these templates — lives exclusively under `strategy/guidance/security/`. Do **not** place security artifacts in `patterns/security/` or `standards/security/`.

**These templates are stored alongside the other generic EA templates in this directory.** Artifacts produced from them are stored in `strategy/guidance/security/` — see §5.0 for the canonical directory layout. This means:

- Generic EA templates (ADR, pattern, standard, white paper) → [`resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/`](./README.md)
- Security TOGAF authoring templates → **this directory** (same location)

## 2.0 Document Chain and Authoring Order

Security guidance artifacts form a **strictly ordered chain**. Each artifact depends on the existence of the documents above it. Do not begin authoring a document until all its prerequisites exist and are at least at `draft` status.
page_texts.5:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#mandatory-authoring-order]

### Mandatory Authoring Order

```
Phase A    →  Architecture Vision
Phase A–B  →  Capability Descriptions
Phase B    →  Capability Map
Phase B–D  →  Composite ABB (one per capability domain)
Phase B–D  →  ABB Catalog  (after all Component ABBs are drafted)
Phase B–D  →  Component ABBs  (one per L2 capability)
Phase C–D  →  Reference Architecture Documents  (one per Component ABB)
Phase E–F  →  Solution Building Blocks  (one per product realization of a Component ABB)
```
page_texts.6:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#chain-diagram]

### Chain Diagram

```
GUID-SEC-<CAP>-VISION-0.D.NN             [Phase A — Architecture Vision]
│
├── GUID-SEC-<CAP>-CAP-DESC-0.D.NN       [Phase A–B — Capability Descriptions]
│
├── GUID-SEC-<CAP>-CAP-MAP-0.D.NN        [Phase B — Capability Map]
│
├── GUID-SEC-<CAP>-ABB-1.D.NN            [Phase B–D — Composite ABB]
│   │
│   ├── GUID-SEC-<CAP>-<TYPE>-2.D.01     [Phase B–D — Component ABB #1]
│   │   └── GUID-SEC-<CAP>-<TYPE>-RAD-3.D.01   [Phase C–D — RAD for ABB #1]
│   │       └── GUID-SEC-<CAP>-<TYPE>-SBB-4.D.01  [Phase E–F — SBB realization]
│   │
│   ├── GUID-SEC-<CAP>-<TYPE>-2.D.02     [Phase B–D — Component ABB #2]
│   │   └── GUID-SEC-<CAP>-<TYPE>-RAD-3.D.02   [Phase C–D — RAD for ABB #2]
│   │
│   └── ...
│
└── GUID-SEC-<CAP>-ABB-MATRIX-2.D.NN     [Phase B–D — ABB Catalog (after all ABBs exist)]
```
page_texts.7:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#hard-prerequisites]

### Hard Prerequisites

| Artifact | Requires These to Exist First |
|---|---|
| Capability Descriptions | Vision |
| Capability Map | Vision, Capability Descriptions |
| Composite ABB | Vision, Capability Map |
| Component ABB | Vision, Composite ABB |
| ABB Catalog | Vision, Composite ABB, all Component ABBs for the domain |
| Reference Architecture | Component ABB it pairs with |
| Solution Building Block | Component ABB and Reference Architecture it realizes |

> **AI authoring agents**: Before generating any artifact, verify prerequisites exist in the repository. If the Vision for the domain does not exist, start there — do not generate a Component ABB without a parent Vision.

[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#30-guid-numbering-scheme]

## 3.0 GUID Numbering Scheme

Every security guidance artifact has a globally unique identifier (GUID) that encodes its type, domain, and position in the ADM phase chain.
page_texts.9:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#format]

### Format

```
GUID-SEC-<CAPABILITY>-<TYPE>-<PHASE>.<DOMAIN>.<SEQ>
```

| Segment | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `GUID-SEC` | Fixed prefix — all security guidance artifacts | `GUID-SEC` |
| `<CAPABILITY>` | Short all-caps abbreviation for the security capability domain | `AI`, `IAM`, `APP`, `NETWORK` |
| `<TYPE>` | Artifact type abbreviation (see table below) | `VISION`, `ABB`, `RAD`, `SBB` |
| `<PHASE>` | ADM phase tier — first digit of the version number | `0`, `1`, `2`, `3`, `4` |
| `<DOMAIN>` | Assigned domain number — second digit (see §4.0) | `9` for AI, `3` for IAM |
| `<SEQ>` | Two-digit sequence within that phase and domain | `01`, `02`, … |
page_texts.10:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#phase-tier-numbers]

### Phase Tier Numbers

| Phase Digit | TOGAF ADM Phase | Artifact Types |
|---|---|---|
| `0` | Phase A (Architecture Vision) | Vision, Capability Descriptions, Capability Map |
| `1` | Phase B–D (Architecture Definition — Composite) | Composite ABB |
| `2` | Phase B–D (Architecture Definition — Component) | Component ABBs, ABB Catalog |
| `3` | Phase C–D (Opportunities & Solutions) | Reference Architecture Documents |
| `4` | Phase E–F (Migration Planning & Implementation) | Solution Building Blocks |

| `CAP-DESC` | Capability Descriptions | `security-capability-descriptions-template.md` |

page_texts.13:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#sequence-number-rules]

### Sequence Number Rules

- `<SEQ>` starts at `01` per `<PHASE>.<DOMAIN>` combination and increments by 1.
- The sequence is **not** shared between phase tiers. Phase 2 Component ABBs and the Phase 2 ABB Catalog have independent sequences within domain `D`.
- The ABB Catalog (`ABB-MATRIX`) shares the Phase 2 sequence pool. Assign it the next available sequence number after the last Component ABB.
- Check existing files in the domain folder before assigning a sequence number to avoid collisions.

[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#40-domain-registry]

## 4.0 Domain Registry

The `<DOMAIN>` digit in the GUID identifies the security capability domain. **Do not reuse or reassign these numbers.**

| Domain # | Capability | `<CAPABILITY>` Tag | Folder |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0` | Overarching / Foundation | *(varies)* | `strategy/guidance/security/` root |
| `1` | Security Operations (SecOps) | `SECOPS` | `strategy/guidance/security/SecOps/` |
| `2` | Network Security | `NETWORK` | `strategy/guidance/security/Network/` |
| `3` | Identity & Access Management (IAM) | `IAM` | `strategy/guidance/security/Identity/` |
| `4` | Endpoint Security | `ENDPOINT` | `strategy/guidance/security/Endpoint/` |
| `5` | Data Security | `DATA` | `strategy/guidance/security/Data/` |
| `6` | Cloud & Infrastructure Security | `CLOUD` | `strategy/guidance/security/Cloud-and-Infrastructure/` |
| `7` | Application Security | `APP` / `APPS` | `strategy/guidance/security/Application/` |
| `8` | Integration Security | `INT` | `strategy/guidance/security/integration-security/` |
| `9` | Artificial Intelligence Security | `AI` | `strategy/guidance/security/Artificial-Intelligence/` |

> **Adding a new domain**: Contact the EA Security Domain lead before assigning a new domain number. The next available number is `10`. Document the assignment in this table before creating any artifacts for the new domain.

[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#50-directory-layout]

## 5.0 Directory Layout

All security guidance artifacts follow this directory structure within `strategy/guidance/security/`.
page_texts.16:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#canonical-layout]

### Canonical Layout

```
strategy/guidance/security/
│
├── GUID-SEC-<CAP>-VISION-0.D.NN.md           ← Vision lives at this level
├── GUID-SEC-<CAP>-CAP-DESC-0.D.NN.md         ← Capability Descriptions (Phase A–B)
│
└── <domain-folder>/                           ← Named by capability (see §4.0)
    │
    ├── GUID-SEC-<CAP>-CAP-MAP-0.D.NN.md      ← Capability Map (Phase B)
    ├── GUID-SEC-<CAP>-ABB-1.D.NN.md          ← Composite ABB
    ├── GUID-SEC-<CAP>-ABB-MATRIX-2.D.NN.md   ← ABB Catalog
    ├── GUID-SEC-<CAP>-<TYPE>-2.D.01.md       ← Component ABBs (Phase B–D)
    ├── GUID-SEC-<CAP>-<TYPE>-2.D.02.md
    ├── ...
    │
    ├── ref-arch/
    │   ├── GUID-SEC-<CAP>-<TYPE>-RAD-3.D.01.md   ← RADs (Phase C–D)
    │   ├── GUID-SEC-<CAP>-<TYPE>-RAD-3.D.02.md
    │   └── ...
    │
    └── sbbs/
        ├── GUID-SEC-<CAP>-<TYPE>-SBB-4.D.01.md   ← SBBs (Phase E–F)
        └── ...
```
page_texts.17:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#layout-rules]

### Layout Rules

| Rule | Detail |
|---|---|
| Vision at `security/` root | Vision spans the full domain and is co-located with the top-level README, not buried in a subfolder |
| Capability Descriptions at `security/` root | Same rationale — describes the full L1/L2 taxonomy, not a single subdomain |
| All other domain artifacts in `<domain-folder>/` | Composite ABB, Component ABBs, ABB Catalog, Capability Map at folder root |
| RADs in `ref-arch/` | All Reference Architecture Documents go in the `ref-arch/` subdirectory of the domain folder |
| SBBs in `sbbs/` | All Solution Building Blocks go in the `sbbs/` subdirectory of the domain folder |
| Create `ref-arch/` and `sbbs/` on demand | Only create these subdirectories when the first RAD or SBB for the domain is added |

[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#70-metadata-field-reference]

## 7.0 Metadata Field Reference

All artifacts use a YAML front-matter block under `## Architecture Guidance Metadata`. The fields below are **mandatory unless marked optional**.
page_texts.20:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#common-fields-all-artifact-types]

### Common Fields (all artifact types)

| Field | Required Values | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `guidance_id` | `'GUID-SEC-<CAP>-<TYPE>-<PHASE>.<DOMAIN>.<SEQ>'` | Must be globally unique — check existing files before assigning |
| `guidance_name` | Descriptive string matching the document `H1` title | |
| `guidance_type` | See §7.1 below | Constrained enum — do not invent new values |
| `adm_phase` | See §7.2 below | Must match the phase tier in the GUID |
| `category` | `'security'` | Fixed value for all artifacts in this directory |
| `version` | `'0.1.0'` for new drafts | Follows semantic versioning; increment on substantive change |
| `status` | `'draft'` \| `'review'` \| `'approved'` \| `'deprecated'` | See §8.0 |
| `applicability` | `'enterprise'` | Default; use `'domain'` only for domain-scoped artifacts |
| `tags` | Array — see §7.3 | Minimum 3 tags required |
| `author` | `'<Author Name>'` | Full name or team name |

[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#72-valid-admphase-values]

### 7.2 Valid `adm_phase` Values

| Value | Use For |
|---|---|
| `'Phase A'` | Architecture Vision |
| `'Phase A-B'` | Capability Descriptions |
| `'Phase B'` | Capability Map |

page_texts.23:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#73-tag-requirements]

### 7.3 Tag Requirements

Tags must include at minimum:

1. **Category tag**: `'security'` (always)
2. **Capability tag**: short slug of the capability (e.g., `'iam'`, `'network'`, `'ai-security'`)
3. **Type tag**: the `guidance_type` value without quotes (e.g., `'architecture-building-block'`)
4. **Phase tags**: the TOGAF phases covered (e.g., `'phase-b'`, `'phase-c'`, `'phase-d'`)
page_texts.24:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#74-abb-specific-fields]

### 7.4 ABB-Specific Fields

These fields apply only to `architecture-building-block` artifacts:

| Field | Required Values | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `abb_type` | `'composite'` \| `'component'` | **Composite**: aggregates multiple Component ABBs. **Component**: leaf-level ABB realized by SBBs |
| `child_abbs` | List of Component ABB GUIDs | **Composite ABBs only** — omit entirely for Component ABBs |
| `parent_abb` | GUID of parent Composite ABB | **Component ABBs only** — omit for Composite ABBs |
| `parent_vision` | GUID of the domain Vision | Required on all ABBs |
| `realized_by_sbbs` | `[]` initially; list SBB GUIDs when created | Leave as `[]` until SBBs are authored |
| `paired_rad` | GUID of the paired RAD | **Component ABBs only** — populate when RAD is created |

[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#80-status-lifecycle]

## 8.0 Status Lifecycle

```
draft  →  review  →  approved
                         ↓
                    deprecated
```

| Status | Meaning | Who Sets It |
|---|---|---|
| `draft` | Being authored; not yet ready for review | Author |
| `review` | Submitted for peer or EA team review via PR | Author (at PR creation) |
| `approved` | Merged to `main` after EA review sign-off | EA team (at merge) |
| `deprecated` | Superseded or retired — do not use for new work | EA team |
page_texts.28:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#rules]

### Rules

- New artifacts **always** start at `version: '0.1.0'` and `status: 'draft'`.
- Status transitions to `approved` only happen at merge to `main` — never set `approved` in a draft PR.
- Deprecated artifacts **must** include a `deprecated_by` metadata field pointing to the superseding GUID, or a note explaining why the artifact was retired.
- Deprecated artifacts are **never deleted** — they remain in the repository as historical record.

page_texts.29:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#90-file-naming-conventions]

## 9.0 File Naming Conventions

Files are named after their GUID, all uppercase, with `.md` extension:

```
GUID-SEC-<CAPABILITY>-<TYPE>-<PHASE>.<DOMAIN>.<SEQ>.md
```

| Rule | Detail |
|---|---|
| All uppercase | `GUID-SEC-AI-VISION-0.9.01.md` — not lowercase |
| Hyphens between segments | Use `-` as the segment separator throughout |
| No spaces in filenames | Use hyphens instead of spaces — `GUID-SEC-AI-APP-2.9.04.md` not `GUID-SEC-AI APP-2.9.04.md` |
| `.md` extension | Always lowercase `.md` |
| GUID = filename = `guidance_id` | The filename (without extension) must match the `guidance_id` metadata field exactly |

> **Legacy exception**: Some older files predate this convention and include spaces (e.g., `GUID-SEC-IAM-NON-HUMAN AND AI-STRATEGY-3.3.01.md`). Do not replicate this pattern in new artifacts.

[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#100-cross-referencing-between-documents]

## 10.0 Cross-Referencing Between Documents

Artifacts in the chain reference each other using relative Markdown links. All links use the relative path from the current file's location.

| Component ABB | Vision | `../GUID-SEC-<CAP>-VISION-0.D.NN.md` |

page_texts.32:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#back-references-mandatory-updates]

### Back-References (Mandatory Updates)

When a new artifact is added, **update all documents that reference it**:

| New Artifact Added | Update These Existing Documents |
|---|---|
| New Component ABB | Composite ABB (`child_abbs` list + Related ABBs table) |
| New Component ABB | ABB Catalog (add row to alignment matrix) |
| New RAD | Paired Component ABB (`paired_rad` metadata field) |
| New SBB | Paired Component ABB (`realized_by_sbbs` list in metadata) |

[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#110-pre-commit-authoring-checklist]

## 11.0 Pre-Commit Authoring Checklist

Complete all items before opening a pull request.
page_texts.34:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/security-template-creation-guidelines.md#identity--metadata]

### Identity & Metadata

- [ ] `guidance_id` is globally unique — checked against all existing files in `strategy/guidance/security/`
- [ ] `guidance_id` matches the filename (without `.md`)
- [ ] `guidance_type` is a value from §7.1 — not a free-text invention
- [ ] `adm_phase` matches the phase tier digit in the GUID (§7.2)
- [ ] `status` is `'draft'`
- [ ] `version` is `'0.1.0'`
- [ ] `tags` include category, capability, type, and phase tags (§7.3)
- [ ] Type-specific fields are present and populated (`abb_type`, `sbb_type`, `rad_type`, etc.)

### Content

- [ ] All `<placeholder>` values in the template have been replaced

### AI Agent Authoring

> If you are an AI agent producing these artifacts, additionally verify:

- [ ] The Vision for this domain exists before generating any downstream artifact
- [ ] GUID sequence numbers do not collide with existing files (list directory contents before assigning)
- [ ] The domain number used matches the Domain Registry in §4.0
